arcs.title: The Duck Waits
arcs.summary: Day 1: A second duck — orange, upright — has appeared on the Jeep's passenger-side mirror, facing southeast, which is the precise bearing of Keeps Ridge from the front drive. The original duck remains on the driver's side facing north-northeast. The two ducks now face each other at forty-seven degrees across the bonnet. No tracks, no note. The Ministry subcommittee has reconvened. Lucy has taken a professional interest. Day 2 should deepen the mystery: perhaps a detail about the orange duck itself (a marking, a number, a small imperfection) that suggests the Bandit knows something specific, or a second sighting — the Bandit seen at the edge of the drive, or another token left nearby. The forty-seven degree angle between ducks may prove significant.
